qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: High street retail price-taker in a hyper-competitive UK grocery and apparel market. Lacks defensible switching costs or scale economies shared against discounters (Aldi, Lidl) and dominant supermarket chains (Tesco, Sainsbury's). 5-year median GAAP ROIC (~7-8%) sits far below the 12% hurdle, with Food operating margins constrained to ~4-5% and exposed to UK national living wage increases and business rates.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3 (Moat Archetype = None, 3b = N, REJECT). UK department and grocery retailer lacks pricing power and defensible structural barriers against discounters (Aldi/Lidl) and online apparel competitors. 5-year median GAAP ROIC (~7-8%) sits well below the 12% hurdle despite recent turnaround progress.
qualitative.evidence: Operating margins in Food hover at ~4.7-5.4% while Fashion/Home reaches ~10-11%, but multi-year GAAP ROIC has averaged ~7-8% over the full 2020-2024 cycle due to lease liabilities, Ocado Retail JV write-downs, and structural UK living wage pressures. Retail price-taker lacking durable pricing power above inflation.
